title: Qualify SDK-on native host release with pending Resource ownership
owner: Root implementation and sole native/build lane
hypothesis: Native automatic UIKit/SwiftUI and manually tracked SwiftUI hosts release while their stopped view still legitimately owns a pending Resource. Advancing the active peer replaces the application restoration owner, so old view and Resource release after completion with original event ownership and unchanged peer.

Complete original Resource once; require one exact URL event under original view, old Resource/view weak nil within2s, unchanged active peer UUID and SDK feature.
Require six mode/cycle receipts bound to three exactly-once executions, complete target compilation and unchanged source/dependencies/artifacts/cleanup.
